safety.lost: This was not saved, so this change is gone. Everything you had before is still here.
safety.partial: Part of it was applied. Everything that was already on this device was kept.

what.invalidFile: That file could not be read.
what.unsupportedPayload: That file is a real export, but not one this screen can read.
what.nothingUsable: That file was read, and there was nothing in it to import.
what.storageQuota: This browser has no room left to store anything.
what.storageUnavailable: This browser is not letting the app store anything.
what.partialImport: Some of that import could not be applied.
what.recognitionFailed: That screenshot could not be read.
what.buildFailed: The build stopped before it finished.
what.searchTooLarge: This search is too large for this browser session.
what.unexpected: Something went wrong that the app did not expect.

action.invalidFile: Check you picked the right file, then try again.
action.unsupportedPayload: Export it again from the screen you want to import it into, then pick that file.
action.nothingUsable: Check you exported the right thing, then try again.
action.storageQuota: Open Settings, export all your data, then remove saved teams, boxes or enemies you no longer need.
action.storageUnavailable: Allow site storage for this browser, or try again in a normal window instead of a private one.
action.saveFailed: Try again. If it keeps failing, open Settings and export your data before doing anything else.
action.loadFailed: Reload the page, or restart the app, then try again.
action.partialImport: Check the parts that were skipped, then import them again on their own.
action.recognitionFailed: Take the screenshot again with the whole box visible, then try again.
action.searchTooLarge: Narrow the types or classes, or fill a slot by hand, then run the search again.
action.unexpected: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
